alerta_locator.name: alerta_locator
alerta_locator.value:
("alerta"."tipo" = 'faltas_excessivas' AND "alerta"."goal_id" IS NULL AND "alerta"."protocol_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("alerta"."tipo" IN ('estagnacao','regressao') AND "alerta"."goal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "alerta"."protocol_id" IS NOT NULL)

alerta_risco_vinculo.name: alerta_risco_vinculo
alerta_risco_vinculo.value:
("alerta_risco_clinico"."pseudonimizado_em" IS NULL
            AND "alerta_risco_clinico"."patient_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "alerta_risco_clinico"."session_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("alerta_risco_clinico"."pseudonimizado_em" IS NOT NULL
            AND "alerta_risco_clinico"."patient_id" IS NULL
            AND "alerta_risco_clinico"."session_id" IS NULL)

bloqueio_escopo_alvo.name: bloqueio_escopo_alvo
bloqueio_escopo_alvo.value:
("bloqueio"."escopo" = 'clinica'   AND "bloqueio"."terapeuta_id" IS NULL AND "bloqueio"."patient_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("bloqueio"."escopo" = 'terapeuta' AND "bloqueio"."terapeuta_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bloqueio"."patient_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("bloqueio"."escopo" = 'paciente'  AND "bloqueio"."patient_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bloqueio"."terapeuta_id" IS NULL)

consent_responsavel_por_tipo.name: consent_responsavel_por_tipo
consent_responsavel_por_tipo.value:
("consent"."tipo"::text = 'tratamento_dados_menor'
    AND "consent"."responsavel_signatario" IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim("consent"."responsavel_signatario") <> ''
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NULL
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("consent"."tipo"::text = 'autoconsentimento_titular_adulto'
    AND "consent"."responsavel_signatario" IS NULL
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NULL
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("consent"."tipo"::text = 'representacao_curador'
    AND "consent"."responsavel_signatario" IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim("consent"."responsavel_signatario") <> ''
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim("consent"."instrumento_representacao") <> ''
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("consent"."tipo"::text = 'autoconsentimento_titular_emancipado'
    AND "consent"."responsavel_signatario" IS NULL
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim("consent"."instrumento_representacao") <> ''
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("consent"."tipo"::text IN ('uso_ia_processamento', 'exportacao_relatorios')
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NULL
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("consent"."tipo"::text = 'revogacao_consentimento'
    AND "consent"."consent_revogado_id" IS NOT NULL
    AND "consent"."instrumento_representacao" IS NULL)

report_exportado_congelado.name: report_exportado_congelado
report_exportado_congelado.value: "report"."status" <> 'exportado' OR ("report"."exportado_por" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."exportado_em" IS NOT NULL AND "report"."pdf_hash" IS NOT NULL)

subscription_ciclo_valido.name: subscription_ciclo_valido
subscription_ciclo_valido.value: "subscription"."ciclo_atual_fim" IS NULL OR "subscription"."ciclo_atual_inicio" IS NULL OR "subscription"."ciclo_atual_fim" > "subscription"."ciclo_atual_inicio"
